svg.text: GENERAL ARRANGEMENT — MULTI-VIEW TECHNICAL SCHEMATIC — SHEET 1 OF 1
ILLUSTRATIVE ENGINEERING SCHEMATIC — FOR CONCEPT REVIEW ONLY. NOT FOR FLIGHT, MANUFACTURE OR FLIGHT-OPERATIONS USE.
ITEM NUMBERS APPEAR ON ALL VIEWS
LONGITUDINAL SECTION ON VEHICLE CENTRELINE PLANE Y = 0 (VIEWED FROM -Y, PORT HALF REMOVED)
1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN METRES (m) AND DEGREES.
2. GEOMETRY IS PROJECTED FROM CAD MASTER HT7-GA-001.MCAT, REV C.
3. VIEWS A, B, C AND D ARE ORTHOGRAPHIC PROJECTIONS ON THE
XZ / XY DATUM PLANES; VIEWS SHARE ONE GEOMETRIC MODEL.
4. SECTION A—A IS CUT ON THE CENTRELINE PLANE Y = 0. HATCHED
AREAS INDICATE CUT MATERIAL; 2 OF 4 ENGINES ARE SHOWN.
5. HIDDEN DETAIL IS SHOWN WITH DASHED LINES.
6. INTERNAL EQUIPMENT LAYOUT IS PROVISIONAL; RACK POSITIONS,
TANK VOLUMES AND HARNESS ROUTING ARE NOT FINAL.
7. LANDING GEAR, SOLAR ARRAYS AND RADIATORS SHOWN DEPLOYED.
8. VEHICLE SHOWN IN ORBITAL TRANSFER CONFIGURATION.
9. DIMENSIONS ARE NOMINAL AND ARE NOT TO BE SCALED.
10. ITEM NUMBERS CROSS-REFERENCE THE PARTS LIST ON THIS SHEET.
C ADD SECTION A-A, ECLSS RACKS
